In [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]], [[Galactic Alliance Intelligence Service|Galactic Alliance Intelligence]] organized a '''mission''' to [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]] to destroy its war-coordinating [[yammosk]], placed there by the occupying [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. [[Galactic Alliance High Command]] expected the Yuuzhan Vong to strike at the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance's]] temporary [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], and anticipated that Caluula would be a staging point for the invaders.

Caluula's [[Governor/Legends|governor]] had surrendered the [[Planet/Legends|world]] peacefully under the condition that several select [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] could visit to observe the natural phenomenon known as the [[Nocturne of the Winged-Stars]], and as such, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Kyp Durron]], [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]], and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Intelligence [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Wraw]] posed as the [[Team Meloque|support team]] of the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] scientist [[Meloque]]. Unbeknownst to any of them save for Wraw, Caluula's governor had in fact surrendered the world so that the Galactic Alliance could test out [[Alpha Red (pathogen)|Alpha Red]], an airborne pathogen designed to target the Yuuzhan Vong and all of their [[Biot|living weapons]]. Wraw was assigned to the task force to report on the pathogen's first field test. Solo suspected that the operation was in some way compromised, and enlisted the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Booster Terrik]] to join them in-[[Caluula system/Legends|system]] with his personal [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]''.

On the planet's surface, Team Meloque hooked up with [[Ferfer]] of the [[Ryn Network]] and [[Sasso]] of the [[Caluula Resistance]]. Over two days, they encountered many sickly and exhausted Yuuzhan Vong [[Warrior caste|warriors]] and biots. After being overcome by a group of Yuuzhan Vong [[Slayers]], they were taken to the [[minshal]] building housing the yammosk, where the Yuuzhan Vong [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Malik Carr]] came before them before he and all of his brethren [[Death/Legends|died]] from the effects of Alpha Red.

As Team Meloque struggled to make sense of the situation, [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], [[Talon Karrde]], and [[Shada D'ukal]] entered the room, all friends of the Solos who had joined Booster Terrik for the operation. They greeted the team and reported seeing dying Yuuzhan Vong at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and on the [[City/Legends|city's]] streets. Durron realized what had happened, having been one of few privy to the knowledge of Alpha Red, and Wraw nonchalantly explained the true nature of the mission to those gathered. He hoped for the Slayers who had departed the planet to bring the pathogen to Yuuzhan Vong-occupied [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and end the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|ongoing war]], but his companions recalled dead [[Insect/Legends|insects]] they had seen and realized that Alpha Red in fact affected more than just the Yuuzhan Vong. Karrde [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] fellow smuggler [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]] aboard the ''Errant Venture'' and discovered, to the team's horror, that one Yuuzhan Vong [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]] had made it to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
